name: go-docs-mcp
description: Lets your AI read PDF, Office files, EPUB, HTML, Jupyter and images, with OCR, search and paging.
long_description:
go-docs-mcp serves the documents of one folder to Claude: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, EPUB, HTML, RTF, Jupyter notebooks, plain text, Markdown, CSV and images. Every tool is read-only, and the server never writes into the folder.

**What this bundle does not include.** The bundle carries the go-docs-mcp binary only. It calls three programs that are not part of it and that you install yourself:

- **poppler** (`pdftotext`, `pdfinfo`, `pdfimages`, `pdftoppm`): without it, PDF files cannot be read. Text, Markdown and CSV still work.
- **tesseract**: without it there is no OCR, so scanned PDFs and images give no text.
- **pandoc**: without it, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, EPUB, HTML, RTF and IPYNB files cannot be read.

On macOS, install them with `brew install poppler tesseract pandoc`. Claude Desktop starts the server with a short `PATH`, so the server looks in `/opt/homebrew/bin` and `/usr/local/bin` first, which is where Homebrew puts them. On Windows and Linux, install them with the system package manager and make sure they are in `PATH`. The `list_formats` tool shows which of them the server found.

tools.name: convert_to_markdown
tools.description: Convert a document to clean Markdown format. Use this when you need structured, readable output from any document; for PDFs headings are detected and formatted, for TXT/CSV content is wrapped in code blocks, and MD files are returned as-is. Long output comes in pages of max_chars characters, like read_document. Read-only.

tools.name: extract_images
tools.description: Extract the embedded images of a PDF as PNG image content, scaled to at most 1600 px on the longer side, 10 per call by default and 8 MB in total. Soft masks are not returned as images. Use this when you need to see figures, charts, or photos embedded in a PDF document. Read-only.

tools.name: extract_tables
tools.description: Extract table-like structures from a document, detecting pipe-delimited, tab-delimited, and multi-space-delimited columns. Use this when you need structured tabular data from a PDF, CSV, or text file. Read-only.

tools.name: get_document_metadata
tools.description: Get document metadata including title, author, dates, page count, and file size. Use this when you need document properties without reading its content; returns full PDF-specific fields (subject, creator, producer, version) for PDF files. Read-only.

tools.name: get_document_outline
tools.description: Extract the heading structure and table of contents from a document. Use this to understand document organization before reading specific sections; detects numbered sections, ALL-CAPS headings, and markdown # headings. Read-only.

tools.name: get_document_summary
tools.description: Get a quick summary by extracting the first 3 pages or ~100 lines of a document. Use this to preview document content before deciding to read it in full. Read-only.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List all documents in the configured directory with format detection and metadata (filename, pages, size). Use this to discover available documents before reading or searching. Read-only.

tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: Show all supported document formats and their dependency installation status. Use this to check which formats are available and diagnose missing dependencies. Read-only.

tools.name: ocr_document
tools.description: Force OCR text extraction on a PDF, bypassing normal text extraction. Use this when read_document returns garbled or empty text from a scanned PDF; requires tesseract and pdftoppm. Read-only.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read text content from a document with optional page selection. Use this when you need the raw text of a PDF, TXT, MD, CSV, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, EPUB, HTML, RTF or IPYNB file; TXT/MD/CSV are returned verbatim, the Office, EPUB, HTML, RTF and notebook formats via pandoc; PDFs support page ranges (e.g. "1-5", "1-3,7,10-12") and auto-OCR fallback for scanned pages. Long texts come in pages of max_chars characters; a truncated result ends with the offset to ask for next. Read-only.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Extract text from a standalone image file (PNG, JPG, WebP, TIFF, BMP) using OCR. Use this when you need to read text from an image rather than a document; supports multiple languages via tesseract. Read-only.

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: Download a document from a URL and extract its text content (max 50MB). Use this when the document is hosted online rather than in the local directory; supports PDF and plain text URLs. Read-only, downloads to a temporary file.

tools.name: search_document
tools.description: Search for text within a document and return matching lines with context and approximate page numbers. Use this when you need to find specific content without reading the entire document. Read-only.

documents_dir.title: Documents folder
documents_dir.description: The folder whose documents Claude can read. The server only reads it.

ocr_language.title: OCR language
ocr_language.description: Tesseract language for OCR when a call names none: eng, spa, or several joined with +, such as eng+spa. The language data must be installed.

disable_read_url.title: Turn off read_url
disable_read_url.description: Removes the read_url tool, so the server never reaches the network.
